name: Geographical Location
definition: Any named place such as city, town, region, country, or physical geographic feature.

name: Person
definition: An individual human being, including historical, fictional, or contemporary persons.

name: Organization
definition: A group or entity such as companies, clubs, political parties, religious institutions, or governmental bodies.

name: Event
definition: A specific occurrence or happening, including sports events, elections, wars, or ceremonies.

name: Creative Work
definition: Artistic or media works such as books, films, TV shows, music albums, songs, plays, or video games.

name: Award or Honor
definition: Named prizes, awards, or honors given to persons or organizations.

name: Political Entity or Governmental Body
definition: Political parties, government institutions, legislatures, or political coalitions.

name: Military Unit or Equipment
definition: Named military units, forces, or specific military equipment and vehicles.

name: Language or Dialect
definition: Named languages, dialects, or linguistic groups.

name: Biological Entity
definition: Living organisms or biological classifications such as species, families, or biochemical substances.

name: Infrastructure or Facility
definition: Physical constructions such as buildings, airports, hospitals, schools, stadiums, or transportation lines.

name: Legal or Regulatory Document
definition: Laws, treaties, acts, or official legal documents.

name: Currency or Monetary Unit
definition: Named currencies, banknotes, coins, or monetary systems.

name: Scientific or Technical Concept
definition: Scientific theories, algorithms, chemical compounds, or technical terms.

name: Sports Team or League
definition: Named sports teams, clubs, leagues, or tournaments.

name: Media Outlet or Publication
definition: Newspapers, magazines, TV channels, radio stations, or other media organizations.

name: Transportation Vehicle or Aircraft
definition: Named vehicles such as airplanes, ships, trains, or automobiles.

name: Religious Entity or Concept
definition: Religious organizations, denominations, figures, or theological concepts.

name: Educational Institution
definition: Schools, universities, or other educational organizations.

name: Chemical or Pharmaceutical Substance
definition: Named chemicals, drugs, or pharmaceutical compounds.

name: Award Ceremony or Festival
definition: Events or ceremonies specifically for awarding or celebrating achievements.

name: Military Conflict or War
definition: Named wars, battles, or military campaigns.

name: Sports Venue or Stadium
definition: Named physical locations where sports events are held.

name: Fictional Entity or Concept
definition: Entities or concepts originating from fiction or mythology.
